proposed_ledger_entry: Item 330 studies the first divided quotient and mod-b^2 direction left open by Item 327. The mechanism passes admission because b is the full beta denominator with log b=n log n+O(n), and the state is forced by the original Item-316 word. For any canonical candidate, set k_j=sign(E_m)E_j, epsilon=(-1)^n sign(E_m), kappa=|E_m|, and Delta=k_(m+1)-a. Then U-epsilon a=epsilon Delta and a^2-b kappa-epsilon R=-a Delta, so Delta is exactly the original target defect. With H,N the Item-323 suffix state and G the digit-independent companion suffix having (G_m,G_(m+1))=(0,1), every depth satisfies kappa H_j+epsilon N_j-aG_j-(-1)^(m+j)k_j=Delta G_j. Since G_(m-1)=1 and adjacent G values are coprime, the integral ideal of the complete divided-quotient bridge portfolio is exactly (Delta), and any adjacent pair already has gcd |Delta|. The normalized higher-lift residual is epsilon L_j-a^2H_j+b(kappa H_j+epsilon N_j)=a Delta H_j; on target this is an exact integer first-lift identity with no higher same-state coefficient. The load tower is also a triangular re-encoding of the original digits. Thus repeated bridge depths and repeated same-state b-adic lifts add no codimension or fresh capacity. Nonlinear arithmetic of the first load, integer-size invariants, redigitization, and external periods remain open. Booking is zero.
